snippet.title: Hockey Beasts - Official Gameplay Trailer | Nintendo Switch, Microsoft Xbox, Steam
snippet.description:
Choose your team, step onto the ice, and see what kind of beast you are when the puck starts moving. Play locally with up to 4 players, or take the competition online with up to 6 players.

The game is coming to Microsoft Xbox and Steam on September 4th with Nintendo Switch release on September 11th.

Check it now!
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/hockey-beasts-switch
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/hockey-beasts/9pbvj60z52bt
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5010400/Hockey_Beasts/
